threeDs.hardwareScope: Initial support targets the New family; hardware compatibility is not yet verified. Old models are not supported.
threeDs.cfwGuide: Studio requires an existing homebrew environment. Check CFW on the console, then follow the current guide if needed. Studio does not install CFW or write firmware.
threeDs.transport: How to access the SD card
threeDs.ftpHelp: Open ftpd on the console and make sure the address it shows matches Settings. Use a trusted local network: ftpd transfers the pairing key without encryption. Close ftpd before opening Pocket.
threeDs.sdHelp: Use the folder containing Nintendo 3DS and boot.firm, such as /Volumes/3DS on macOS or E:\ on Windows. After writing, safely eject the card and return it to the console.
threeDs.reusePair: Reuse and verify the existing pairing key.
threeDs.newPair: Create a native pairing key and verify it after writing.
threeDs.setupConfirm: Confirm the destination and files. A 3DSX launcher at the listed path will be replaced. CIA files are staged for installation with FBI.
threeDs.filesVerified: Files were written and verified by reading them back.
threeDs.fbiNext: On the console, open FBI and install the copied CIA from the cias folder, then start Pocket Launcher. When it shows it is ready, verify the connection here.
threeDs.restartNext: Start Pocket Launcher on the console (a 3DSX from the Homebrew Launcher). When it shows it is ready, verify the connection here.
threeDs.nativeSelfUpgrade: Launcher CIA upgrades use FBI; 3DSX upgrades replace the SD file. Restart Pocket to verify the new Runtime.
threeDs.deliveryHelp: Both forms can coexist. Their app data, versions and rollback history are separate.
threeDs.alreadyInstalled: This instance is already installed. Update or remove it from Installed.
threeDs.noCandidate: No published artifact is available for this form.
threeDs.hostRequirement: Requires Runtime {version} or newer and host ABI {abi}.

errors.unknown: Preparation failed. Check the destination and create a new plan.
errors.invalid3dsCard: Select a prepared 3DS card root with Nintendo 3DS and boot.firm.
errors.invalidPairingKey: The pairing key is malformed. Restore the correct key before pairing.
errors.setupStorageFailed: The selected files could not be written and verified.
errors.deviceChanged: The destination changed. Review a new plan.
errors.planExpired: This plan has expired. Review a new plan.
errors.runtimeRequired: The signed Store does not contain a compatible Pocket Launcher. Publish the launcher first, or choose pairing only for an existing Runtime.
errors.pairingUnavailable: The console answered but its identity could not be verified. Restart Pocket on the console and retry.
errors.invalidCatalog: The store catalog could not be read: its format is incompatible with this Studio version, or its data is damaged. Use a compatible store source and retry.
errors.storeObjectNotFound: The required launcher file is absent from the catalog. Refresh the catalog and retry.
errors.ftpRootUnavailable: Connected to ftpd, but Nintendo 3DS or boot.firm on the console SD card is inaccessible. Check the exposed directory and read permissions.
errors.ftpConnectionFailed: The ftpd connection failed or was interrupted. Keep ftpd running and check the console IP and port.
errors.ftpAuthenticationFailed: ftpd rejected the login. Check its username and password.
errors.invalidFtpResponse: ftpd returned an unexpected response. Check its status and retry.
errors.hostUnreachable: The console did not answer. Make sure the SD card is back in the console and that PocketJS Launcher or an app with its own Pocket Runtime is running and shows it is ready, then check that the console IP in Settings is its current address.
errors.pairingRejected: The console rejected the pairing: pocketjs/runtime/dev.key on the card differs from the one the console is using, or a different console answered. Restart Pocket on the console and retry.
errors.artifactUnavailable: The store has no file for this application that can be copied to the SD card.

threeDs.verifyPrepared: Restart Pocket and verify the connection and host version.
threeDs.planAgain: Generate a new app plan for the selected installation form.
threeDs.unavailable: This installation could not be verified

formatHelp.cia: Choose CIA to open Pocket from the HOME Menu. After copying, install it using FBI on your 3DS.
formatHelp.3dsx: Choose 3DSX if you already use Homebrew Launcher and want to open Pocket there. Files will be copied to its SD folder.

threeDs.storeFailure: Could not load the launcher from the store: {reason}

deliveryHint.shared: Runs inside the launcher and shares its runtime.
deliveryHint.bundled: Installs as its own title with a private runtime.

threeDs.launcherIntro: Copies the Pocket launcher to the console's SD card: a CIA is installed with FBI, a 3DSX goes into the Homebrew Launcher folder. Studio does not install CFW or write firmware.
threeDs.noAddress: No console address yet. Enter the 3DS IP and ftpd account in Settings first.
threeDs.cardIntro: An app with its own Runtime works without Pocket Launcher: copy its CIA or 3DSX to the console's SD card and install it with FBI or the Homebrew Launcher. While that app runs, Studio can connect and update it.
threeDs.cardFbiNext: On the console, open FBI, install the copied CIA from the cias folder and start it. Once the app shows it is ready, verify the connection here so Studio can update it later.
threeDs.cardHbNext: On the console, open the Homebrew Launcher and start the copied app. Once it shows it is ready, verify the connection here so Studio can update it later.
threeDs.connectNext: Put the SD card back into the console (close ftpd first if you used it), then start PocketJS Launcher or any app with its own Pocket Runtime. When it shows it is ready, press Verify connection.
threeDs.modelLauncher: With Pocket Launcher: Studio installs, updates and removes every app over Wi-Fi.
threeDs.modelStandalone: Without the launcher: copy an app with its own Runtime to the SD card and install it with FBI; Studio connects and updates it while it runs.
threeDs.modelsShared: Both ways start with the pairing key and need custom firmware on the console.
threeDs.cardConfirm: Confirm the destination and files. A copied CIA still has to be installed with FBI; a 3DSX replaces the file at the listed path.
